Le toner coréen, c’est fait pour recharger la peau en eau, pas pour l’assécher. Quand je suis arrivée en France il y a 6 ans, je cherchais mon toner partout — et je le trouvais pas. Et ce qui m’a encore plus choquée, c’est que mes amies françaises n’en utilisaient pas du tout. Pour elles, c’était pas une étape. Moi, j’oublie parfois ma crème. Mais mon toner ? Skincare Ingredients — AM☀️ vs PM🌙 Wondering if you're using your skincare at the right time? Here's a pharmacist’s guide to AM vs PM skincare timing ⏰ ☀️ Vitamin C - AM > PM → Pairs with SPF to fight free radical damage from UV exposure ☀️ Niacinamide - AM > PM → Flexible ingredient, but in the morning it calms skin and balances oil before sunscreen and makeup 🔄 Hyaluronic Acid - AM & PM → Works 24/7. Must apply on damp skin to lock in deep hydration 🔄 Ceramides - AM & PM → Essential for barrier repair, especially after using retinoids or acids 🌙 Retinol - PM only → It breaks down in sunlight and increases sun sensitivity 🌙 Salicylic Acid - AM < PM → Works either time, but preferred at night to deep-clean pores while the skin regenerates overnight 🌙 Lactic Acid - PM only → Gentle AHA that exfoliates surface cells but increases sun sensitivity  Save this for your next skincare routine — and follow for Part 2 ✨ #skintok #niacinamide #retinol #skincareroutine #hyaluronicacid
